content.comment_body: Hello. I am able to export a [product_name] project to [product_name] program. Thank you.
Hello, You cannot do this automatically. It's necessary to rebuild the software in [product_name] starting from scratch. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you. SCADA programming can be applied with [product_name]. I aim to implement a lift and monitor its status.
No, that's not possible. However, you might want to review [url] for possible alternatives with [article_no] and [product_name] panel plus [product_name]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking to transfer project files between two different [product_name] platforms but finds that automatic export or import is not supported, requiring manual project recreation. There is also interest in combining SCADA functionalities and monitoring states for lift operations using [product_name], but such features are not natively supported.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates direct export and import functionality between [product_name] systems, along with built-in support for SCADA and lift status monitoring in [product_name] projects.
